pages: ACCESSORY KIT INSTALLATION MANUAL COMMUNICATING ZONE THERMOSTAT KIT - (S1-ZCC01*) FOR USE WITH Hx™3 ZONE MODULE: S1-ZMC401* GENERAL INFORMATION The Hx™3 Zone Thermostat is used to communicate the corresponding zone's temperature, humidity, setpoints and system mode to the Hx™3 Zone Module (S1-ZMC401*). Kit Contents The following list details the parts included in this kit. Examine the kit to ensure that all parts are included. MOUNTING THE ZONE THERMOSTAT ! WARNING Voltage Hazard: Live wires can cause electrical shock or equipment damage. Disconnect power before beginning installation. 1. If an existing thermostat/control/sensor is being replaced: a. Remove existing control from wall. b. Disconnect wires from existing control. c. Properly discard or recycle the old control. NOTICE Mercury is a hazardous substance, if existing thermostat or control contains any mercury, it MUST be disposed of properly. The Zone Thermostat does not contain mercury. 2. Mark on the wall where the Zone Thermostat will be mounted (standard height is 5 feet from the floor). NOTICE If an existing thermostat or sensor was in place, it may be ideal to use the same location for the Zone Thermostat. 3. Create a small hole in the wall for the communicating wires. 4. Using the mounting back plate as a template, mark the screw holes on the surface where the Zone Thermostat will mount. Use a level to insure proper installation. 5. Remove mounting back plate and drill holes (3/16" in diameter) in the marked area to accommodate the anchors (provided in the kit). 6. Place anchors in the pre-drilled holes. Be sure that the anchors are fully inserted. 7. Pull low voltage wires through the mounting back plate, screw the mounting back plate to the wall using the screws provided in the kit. 8. Connect low voltage wires (A, R, C, B) to the zone thermostat. 9. Align the Zone Thermostat faceplate with the backplate and snap together. The Zone Thermostat is now installed and ready to be configured as a part of the Hx™3 Zone Module. NOTICE The date and time on the Zone Thermostat are set and updated by the Hx™3 Touch Screen Thermostat (Main Control). REMOVING ZONE THERMOSTAT If there is a need to remove the faceplate, release the latches on the bottom edge of the faceplate and pull away. Subject to change without notice. Published in U.S.A.
